claim: Plage des Sablettes is composed of very fine gravel (gravillons très fins), spans ~350 m at Quai Bonaparte between Vieux Port and Garavan, and is supervised in summer with a rescue post.
quote: gravillons très fins ... spanning approximately 350 meters ... surveillée pendant la saison estivale ... rescue post located near the private beach sections

claim: Plage du Fossan is a public non-smoking beach of pebbles with sandy patches, lifeguarded in summer, with wooden boardwalk, lockers and family rentals.
quote: Plage du Fossan ... Pebbles with sandy patches ... Public (non-smoking area) ... Yes (summer) ... Wooden boardwalk, lockers, sports facilities, pirate ships and pedal horse rentals

claim: Plage du Borrigo is Menton's westernmost wide pebble beach, public, summer-monitored, with beach restaurants on site.
quote: Plage du Borrigo ... Wide pebble beach ... Public ... Monitored (summer) ... Beach restaurants available

claim: Plage Hawaï is a narrow public pebble beach in eastern Garavan with showers, free parking and seasonal lifeguards.
quote: Plage Hawaï ... narrow pebble beach ... Public ... Yes (summer) ... Shower facilities, free parking nearby

claim: Plage Rondelli (Garavan) is described as a public sandy beach with summer lifeguards, first-aid post and adjacent car park.
quote: Plage Rondelli ... Sandy beach ... Public ... Yes (summer) ... First-aid post, adjacent car park

claim: Plage du Casino is a public beach of large pebbles with sandy patches, lifeguarded in summer, with restaurants, showers and an accessible ramp.
quote: Plage du Casino ... Large pebbles and a number of sandy patches ... Public ... Yes (summer) ... Restaurants, toilet/shower facilities, accessible ramp

claim: Plage Hawaï sits 1 km from the Italian border, allows dogs and fishing, and is marketed as 'the last beach in France' with limited dining (bring a picnic).
quote: Located just 1km from Italy, this quiet, narrow pebble beach allows dogs and fishing. It's 'the last beach in France' ... Limited dining options suggest bringing a picnic.

claim: Plage du Fossan stretches ~500 m along Quai Général Leclerc next to the old town, is designated non-smoking and offers secure yellow lockers and showers.
quote: Plage de Fossan ... next to the old town along Quai Gènéral Leclerc, this 500-meter public beach combines sand and pebbles ... 'a non-smoking beach' ... Secure yellow boxes store belongings

claim: Menton sea temperature averages 17.9°C across May, with late-May (May 22–27) averaging ~19.8°C, ranging from 16.3°C to 22.5°C.
quote: Overall May Average: 17.9°C ... Late May Specifics (May 22-27): Average: Approximately 19.8°C ... Minimum: 16.3°C (May 22) ... Maximum: 22.5°C (May 27)

claim: Phase 1 of a €4.1M wave-attenuator coastal-protection project on Plage des Sablettes finished before summer 2026 (inaugurated 13 April 2026); Phase 2 (pontoon + Plage Hawaï renaturalization) runs Oct 2026–Apr 2027.
quote: Phase 1 (Completed): January 2026 to June 2026 - Creation of a wave attenuator ... inaugurated on Monday, April 13, 2026. Phase 2: October 2026 to April 2027 - Work on the pontoon and Plage Hawai

claim: Menton's private beach clubs include Les Sablettes Beach Club (with online booking), CalaBro Beach Club, La Cabane Plage, La Dolce Vita and La Pergola, typically open May–September 9am–7pm at €20–80/day.
quote: CalaBro Beach Club ... La Cabane Plage ... La Dolce Vita ... La Pergola ... Les Sablettes Beach Club ... operate seasonally from May through September, generally welcoming visitors between 9 AM and 7 PM, with daily rates ranging from approximately €20-€80

claim: Menton Nautique Club at the Vieux Port rents single kayaks (€15–20/h), double kayaks (€25–35/h) and paddleboards (€15–18/h), though promenade construction has suspended rentals as of mid-2025.
quote: Menton Nautique Club is located on the Vieux Port and offers rentals of single kayaks (15-20€/h), double kayaks (25-35€/h), and paddleboards (15-18€/h) ... due to construction work on the promenade de la mer, the nautical center is no longer able to offer rentals

claim: Public beaches along the Promenade du Soleil (including Plage du Marché between Fossan and Casino Barrière) are lifeguarded only 1 July–31 August.
quote: All the beaches are monitored by lifeguards in summer, from July 1st to August 31st ... Plage du Marché stretches between Plage du Fossan and the Casino Barrière, right along the Promenade du Soleil
